title: Online Conditional Vine Copulas: Forecasting Electricity Demand
note: Abstract: online covariate-conditioned vine copula; beats unconditional Gaussian and vine copula benchmarks on net demand in five GB regions; online updating helps when batch refit unavailable. Implemented in Python package ondil.

title: Online Conditional Vine Copulas (HTML full text)
note: Half-hourly GB net demand, 2014-2018, five macro-regions; test year 2018 in 12 monthly blocks; one-step-ahead (30 min); weather covariates (source realised-vs-forecast unstated); log score 3.80 vs 3.84 best competitor; no CIs, MCS p-values; no pre-registration. Replication repo github.com/chrischu12/online-vine-copulas.

title: ondil: online distributional learning
note: Python package for online distributional regression, GPL-3.0; no releases listed; no pretrained weights; vine copulas not mentioned on the page.
